documents.title: Klimatklivet Handbook 2023
documents.content: Klimatklivet prioritises investments that deliver measurable CO2e reductions within Sweden and are led by municipalities or SMEs registered in the country.

documents.title: Stockholm Municipality EV Guidance
documents.content: Stockholm municipality recommends EV fast chargers rated at 150 kW or higher and requires applicants to submit a baseline emissions inventory using the municipal template.

documents.title: Horizon Europe Mission Climate
documents.content: Projects must include international partnerships and clearly articulate cross-border impact pathways aligned with the Horizon Europe Mission on Climate-Neutral and Smart Cities.

documents.title: Green Deal Call Guidance
documents.content: Applicants should attach supplier quotes and lifecycle analyses demonstrating alignment with EU Green Deal sustainability taxonomy.
